pick.name: Manual LinkedIn + Apollo Chrome extension
pick.what: Personal profile content + manual connection requests/DMs; Apollo extension for contact data
pick.why: Free and inside LinkedIn's User Agreement, which bans bots, automation and scraping plugins (s.8.2)

alts.name: LinkedIn Sales Navigator Core
alts.why: Best enterprise account mapping; USD 119.99/mo or USD 1,079.88/yr; buy for focused enterprise pushes only

alts.name: Waalaxy
alts.why: Cheapest automation (Pro EUR 19/mo, 300 invites/mo) but violates LinkedIn's UA and risks restriction

candidates.name: Waalaxy / Expandi / HeyReach / Dripify
candidates.verdict: Automation; account-ban risk under UA s.8.2

decision: Post consistently and send personal connection notes by hand; that is the safe, free channel. Rent Sales Navigator a month at a time for enterprise account mapping. Avoid automation tools on the account you sell from.

verify.note: User Agreement s.8.2 items 2 (scraping incl. browser plugins/add-ons) and 13 (bots/automation) confirmed. Note that the Apollo extension's profile-data copying sits close to item 2; use it for lookup, not bulk scraping.
